text.content:
The nation Night City isn't part of, and the army that stopped at its gates.

Kind: National government
Leadership: President Rosalind Myers, former Militech CEO
Purpose: Reuniting America, by force if need be

President Elizabeth Kress ruled for more than three decades after the Time of the Red. In 2047 Trace Santiago's exposé, believed at last, proved Militech had set off the 2023 bomb that Kress had blamed on Arasaka for twenty-four years. Five years of hearings, leaks and resignations followed; in 2053 a new Constitution was ratified, Kress stepped down, and the NUSA held its first elections. The new President owed his campaign to Militech, and the presidents since have come from the corporate world.

Rosalind Myers, ex-CEO of Militech, launched the Unification War against the Free States in 2069. By spring 2070 the NUSA 4th Army sat at Night City's edge; it stopped when an Arasaka supercarrier sailed into Coronado Bay, and the Arvin Accord in June made Night City a Free City belonging to no nation. The NUSA withdrew, except for Colonel Hansen's Barghest, whom Washington disowns as AWOL.

NUSA citizens now need a visa to enter Night City. The NUSA calls Free City passports "travel documents" to avoid using the word.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.16; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 05
